events.title: The Fatherhood Huddle
events.description: The Fatherhood Huddle is the Autism Dads Social Club's virtual discussion series designed to encourage, equip, and connect fathers raising autistic children. Through conversations with experienced dads and professionals, participants gain practical parenting insights, emotional support, and a welcoming brotherhood where no father has to navigate the autism journey alone.

events.title: Back to School Autism Resource Fair
events.description: Join Autism Caregivers Around the Bend and Autism Dads Social Club at the Missouri City Community Center for a morning filled with valuable resources and information for families rearing autistic loved ones. Connect with local organizations, therapists, educators, and specialists who can help support you and your loved ones as you navigate the school year. We will have vendors, a panel, and fun activities to engage kids on the spectrum and their siblings. Light food and refreshments will be provided.

events.title: Trunk or Treat
events.location: We Rock the Spectrum - West Houston, Katy, Texas
events.description:
Join us for Trunk or Treat fun tailored just for autism families—safe, sweet, and full of smiles!

Get ready for a fun and friendly event designed especially for autism families as we celebrate One Year of Boo-tiful Memories at We Rock the Spectrum West Houston! 🎃

Enjoy a safe, welcoming space where kids can show off their costumes, collect treats, and make new friends. Don't miss out on this super fun way to connect with autism service providers and other families in the autism community.


Event Highlights

Free Candy

Decorated Trunks

Free Open Play at We Rock the Spectrum-West Houston

Costume Contest

Door Prizes and More

events.title: Fishing Excursion
events.description:
ADSC is Going Fishing in Galveston!

Our next Autism Dads Social Club adventure is headed to Galveston! Join us aboard the Galveston Party Boat for a day of fishing, fellowship, and brotherhood. Come connect with fellow dads, build friendships, and enjoy some time on the water.
Cost: $40 per dad (Rod, reel, squid, and stringer are provided.) ADSC will submit payment as a group.

Whether you’re a longtime member or joining us for the first time, we’d love to have you aboard. Let’s fish, fellowship, and have some fun, fellas! 

We’ll see you in Galveston! 🎣
